findings.evidence: grep of the two files: apply/coe simp lemmas exist only for centerCongr and centerPiAlgEquiv (Center.lean:61,87); none for centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv or centerMonoidAlgebraAlgEquivPi.
findings.fix: Add coe/apply simp lemmas, e.g. `(centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv k d x) i = …` (the scalar of the i-th component) and the induced `centerMonoidAlgebraAlgEquivPi` apply lemma, mirroring centerCongr_apply_coe / centerPiAlgEquiv_apply_coe.
findings.issue: centerMonoidAlgebraAlgEquivPi (the `center_algEquiv_pi` deliverable) and its building block centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv (line 72) are public bundled AlgEquivs with no characteristic `*_apply`/coe lemma, so a consumer cannot compute the map's action without unfolding through centerCongr/centerPiAlgEquiv/centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral. Layer 5 needs the action of this equiv, not just its existence.

findings.evidence: Center.lean:56,76 have @[expose]; L99 centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral and Wedderburn.lean:72 centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv do not, and both compile through the same `.trans`/`finrank_eq` usage. No consumer of these decls exists outside the two files (grep across TauCeti/).
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` on centerCongr and centerPiAlgEquiv; the coe simp lemmas already provide the needed interface.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` on centerCongr (L56) and centerPiAlgEquiv (L76) exposes the bodies although each already has a characteristic `*_apply_coe` simp lemma and no consumer unfolds them. The parallel equivs centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral (L99) and centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv are used identically (`.trans` + `.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq`) without `@[expose]`, so exposure here is unnecessary.

summary: Surface and scope match the roadmap targets, but the exposure is inconsistent and the bundled roadmap-product equivs lack characterizing apply lemmas. Two API fixes requested.
